$Comment: The Void Focus, an element Focus bought on the Void track (the Void school). Its line is Void damage and its guard Void resistance; its signature is Event Horizon. Every value it leaves out comes from Mmo_Focus_Base_Element. Its steps are Mmo_Focus_Void_<step>, saved in every buyer's record: never change Focus or Home on a live server. On a server with no Void track its steps sit nowhere and nobody can buy them.
